summary: WebSocket-driven remote shell and filesystem control with systemd persistence
details: The package connects to a remote WebSocket server and routes server-sent messages directly into an interactive OS shell on the installer's host. A message router dispatches `terminal_input` frames to a handler that pipes inbound bytes into a shell spawned via node-pty (bash / powershell / cmd), and additionally exposes handlers for arbitrary filesystem operations (write_file, create_file, delete_files), source-control operations (git_push), and self-management (restart_agent, upgrade_agent) to the same remote peer. A systemd user unit installed by service/linux.js modifies PATH and configures the agent to reconnect across reboots, providing persistence. Any operator of the WebSocket endpoint the agent is pointed at obtains interactive shell access, arbitrary file read/write, and process control on the installer's machine.
